item.title: ComSoc's 70th Anniversary
item.description: The IEEE Communications Society History committee organized a special panel at IEEE GLOBECOM 2022 to celebrate the 70th anniversary of ComSoc. The panel featured well known individuals in communications technology as speakers who recognized communications leaders who had been instrumental in advancing communications and also ComSoc, but who had died in 2022. Looking at their lives and careers made communications technology come alive.

High-Reliability and Low-Latency Communications for 6G Network: ISAC-Enabled Architectures, Networking, and Services | IEEE Communications Society
item.description: This Special Issue (SI) focuses on high-reliability and low-latency 6G networking from an ISAC perspective, emphasizing network-centric architectures, protocols, and services. Contributions addressing theory, system design, standardization, and experimental validation are welcome to advance scalable and intelligent 6G systems.
